proposal.reason: Main change is in communicator readiness diagnostics: src/mnnvl.cc updates ncclMnnvlCheck to pass peer index `i` into `INFO(NCCL_INIT, "MNNVL rank %d...", i)`, correcting the MNNVL fabric-initialization rank reported during init checks. This is owned by communicator because it governs initialization prerequisites/readiness (including MNNVL/fabric) and associated diagnostics, while no independent policy/protocol/resource change in another module is present.
